longBusinessSummary: Honeywell Aerospace Inc. supplies mission critical systems and technologies that enable the production, maintenance, and safe operation of aerospace and defense platforms. It operates through three segments: Electronic Solutions (ES), Engines & Power Systems (E&PS), and Control Systems (CS). The ES segment provides avionics, radars, flight management systems, precision inertial navigation systems, and space components; solutions that enable complex sensing protection, targeting, and communications operations in the electromagnetic spectrum; and electronic warfare solutions, as well as solutions that focus on in-flight connectivity, cockpit safety, defense radiofrequency, and counter unmanned aerial systems.
